answer: With trust seeded in an honest core, scores propagate through at most L steps of a normalized random walk on the attestation graph. A sybil cluster S with low conductance, φ(S)=cut(S,¬S)/vol(S), has few edges for trust to cross; under this seeding assumption, min-cut and transitivity bounds constrain incoming walk mass and therefore its aggregate voting weight, regardless of how many ocean, forge, or dune identities it creates internally.
